# setup
## libraries
```{r}
# ── packages ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(arrow)

arrow::set_cpu_count(4)

# ── project functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
source('../functions/params.R')
source('../functions/theme.R')
source('../functions/general.R')
source('../functions/r_general.R')
source('../functions/analysis_peth.R')
source('../logs_and_keys/key_local_directories.R')
```

## directories
```{r}
dir_localdata_sessions <- '../data/sessions/'
dir_output             <- '../data/combined_setid/'

dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## logs / keys
```{r}
# ── analysis inclusion / exclusion log (local xlsx) ──────────────────────────
log_analysis_subjects <- read_xlsx('../logs_and_keys/log_data_analysis.xlsx', sheet = 'subjects',    na = c('NA', ''))
log_analysis_fp       <- read_xlsx('../logs_and_keys/log_data_analysis.xlsx', sheet = 'fp',          na = c('NA', ''))
log_analysis_exp      <- read_xlsx('../logs_and_keys/log_data_analysis.xlsx', sheet = 'experiments', na = c('NA', ''))

log_placements <- read.csv('../logs_and_keys/log_fiber_placements.csv', na.strings = c('', 'NA'))
```

## session filter
```{r}
# ── session-level import key ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
log_data <- log_analysis_fp %>%
  filter(is.na(exclude) | exclude != 1) %>%
  get_set_id() %>%
  filter(!is.na(set_id))

join_info <- log_data %>%
  select(blockname, experiment, subject, set_id)

# ── set_ids included in paper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
loop_set_ids <- log_data$set_id %>% unique()
```

## QC metrics
```{r}
# ── read per-session signal quality metrics ───────────────────────────────────
fns_qc_metrics <- list.files(dir_localdata_sessions, pattern = 'quality_metrics.csv',
                              recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

combined_qc_metrics <- bind_rows(lapply(fns_qc_metrics, read.csv))
```

---

# fp peth aggregation
```{r}
# ── PETH parameters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
peth_filt_fulltrace <- c(-3, 8)

peth_tm_bins <- tibble(
  tm_bin_id =    c('access', 'prelick', 'sustained', 'post'),
  tm_bin_start = c(       0,         0,           2,      6),
  tm_bin_end   = c(       3,       0.3,           3,      8)
)

# minimum lick onset for triallick-filtered outputs (end of prelick window, in ms)
tm_min_lick_onset <- peth_tm_bins %>% filter(tm_bin_id == 'prelick') %>% pull(tm_bin_end) * 1000
```

```{r}
for(loop_set_id in loop_set_ids) {
  print(str_c('processing set_id: ', loop_set_id))

  # ── load and filter sessions for this set_id ────────────────────────────────
  process_blocknames_setid <- log_data %>%
    filter(set_id == loop_set_id) %>%
    pull(blockname)

  df_fp_peth <- combine_session_fp(process_blocknames_setid, dir_localdata_sessions) %>%
    left_join(log_analysis_fp %>% select(blockname, subject), by = 'blockname')

  df_fp_peth <- df_fp_peth %>%
    filter_qc_metrics(combined_qc_metrics, removal_type = 1) %>%  # remove poor-signal fibers
    format_regions('region', key_regions) %>%                      # standardise region label strings
    filter_placements('exclude_da_consumption') %>%                # remove histologically misplaced fibers
    filter(time_rel > peth_filt_fulltrace[1], time_rel < peth_filt_fulltrace[2]) %>%
    left_join(join_info, by = c('blockname', 'subject'))

  # ── inner loop: all trials (full) and lick trials only (filtlick) ───────────
  for(toggle_filt_trial_lick in c(0, 1)) {

    df_filt <- df_fp_peth

    if(toggle_filt_trial_lick == 1) {
      df_filt    <- df_filt %>% filter(trial_lick == 1)
      fn_prefix  <- str_c(loop_set_id, '_filtlick')
    } else {
      fn_prefix  <- str_c(loop_set_id, '_full')
    }

    # ── trace: population-level ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    df_filt %>%
      group_by(set_id, region, solution, time_rel) %>%
      get_mean_signals() %>%
      write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_peth_summary_trace_overall.csv'))

    # ── trace: split by trial_lick flag (full only) ───────────────────────────
    if(toggle_filt_trial_lick == 0) {
      df_filt %>%
        filter(lick_ts_first > tm_min_lick_onset | is.na(lick_ts_first)) %>%
        group_by(set_id, region, trial_lick, time_rel) %>%
        get_mean_signals() %>%
        write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_peth_summary_trace_triallick.csv'))
    }

    # ── trace: subject-level ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    df_filt %>%
      group_by(experiment, subject, set_id, region, solution, time_rel) %>%
      get_mean_signals() %>%
      write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_peth_summary_trace_subject.csv'))

    # ── means: subject-level ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    grouping_vars <- c('experiment', 'subject', 'set_id', 'region', 'solution', 'time_bin')

    df_filt %>%
      left_join(join_info, by = join_by(blockname, subject, experiment, set_id)) %>%
      get_peth_binned_summary(peth_tm_bins, grouping_vars) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_peth_summary_means_subject.csv'))

    # ── means: subject × trial_lick (full only) ───────────────────────────────
    if(toggle_filt_trial_lick == 0) {
      grouping_vars <- c('experiment', 'subject', 'set_id', 'region', 'trial_lick', 'time_bin')

      df_filt %>%
        left_join(join_info, by = join_by(blockname, subject, experiment, set_id)) %>%
        filter(lick_ts_first > tm_min_lick_onset | is.na(lick_ts_first)) %>%
        get_peth_binned_summary(peth_tm_bins, grouping_vars) %>%
        write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_peth_summary_means_subject_triallick.csv'))
    }

    # ── means: trial-level ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    grouping_vars <- c('experiment', 'blockname', 'subject', 'set_id', 'region',
                       'trial_num', 'solution', 'time_bin',
                       'lick_count', 'lick_ts_first', 'lick_ts_last')

    df_filt %>%
      get_peth_binned_summary(peth_tm_bins, grouping_vars) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_peth_summary_means_trial.csv'))

    # ── means: trial × trial_lick (full only) ────────────────────────────────
    if(toggle_filt_trial_lick == 0) {
      grouping_vars <- c('experiment', 'blockname', 'subject', 'set_id', 'region',
                         'trial_num', 'trial_lick', 'time_bin',
                         'lick_count', 'lick_ts_first', 'lick_ts_last')

      df_filt %>%
        filter(lick_ts_first > tm_min_lick_onset | is.na(lick_ts_first)) %>%
        get_peth_binned_summary(peth_tm_bins, grouping_vars) %>%
        write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_peth_summary_means_trial_triallick.csv'))
    }

    # ── means: binned-trial ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    grouping_vars <- c('experiment', 'blockname', 'subject', 'set_id', 'region',
                       'bin_trial', 'solution', 'time_bin')

    df_filt %>%
      mutate(bin_trial = cut(trial_num, seq(0, 100, 10), labels = sprintf("%02d", seq(0, 90, 10)))) %>%
      mutate(bin_trial = as.character(bin_trial)) %>%
      get_peth_binned_summary(peth_tm_bins, grouping_vars) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_peth_summary_means_binnedtrial.csv'))

    # ── means: binned-trial × trial_lick (full only) ─────────────────────────
    if(toggle_filt_trial_lick == 0) {
      grouping_vars <- c('experiment', 'blockname', 'subject', 'set_id', 'region',
                         'bin_trial', 'trial_lick', 'time_bin')

      df_filt %>%
        filter(lick_ts_first > tm_min_lick_onset | is.na(lick_ts_first)) %>%
        mutate(bin_trial = cut(trial_num, seq(0, 100, 10), labels = sprintf("%02d", seq(0, 90, 10)))) %>%
        mutate(bin_trial = as.character(bin_trial)) %>%
        get_peth_binned_summary(peth_tm_bins, grouping_vars) %>%
        write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_peth_summary_means_binnedtrial_triallick.csv'))
    }

  } # end toggle_filt_trial_lick loop

  rm(df_fp_peth, df_filt)
  gc()

} # end set_id loop
```

# licking aggregation
```{r}
# ── spout summary: mean lick count and trial lick proportion per subject ──────
process_blocknames_all <- log_data %>%
  filter(set_id %in% loop_set_ids) %>%
  pull(blockname)

combine_session_files(process_blocknames_all, dir_localdata_sessions, '_data_spout_summary.csv') %>%
  left_join(join_info, by = 'blockname') %>%
  group_by(experiment, subject, set_id, solution) %>%
  summarise(
    lick_count_trial_mean  = mean(lick_count_trial_mean),
    trial_lick_proportion  = mean(trial_lick_proportion),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  write_csv(str_c(dir_output, 'licking_spout_summary.csv'))
```

```{r}
# ── trial summary: per-trial lick data ───────────────────────────────────────
combine_session_files(process_blocknames_all, dir_localdata_sessions, '_data_trial_summary.csv') %>%
  left_join(join_info, by = 'blockname') %>%
  mutate(lick_ts_first = lick_ts_first / 1000) %>%
  write_csv(str_c(dir_output, 'licking_trial_summary.csv'))
```

```{r}
# ── binned lick rate trace ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_binnedlick <- combine_session_binnedlick(process_blocknames_all, dir_localdata_sessions) %>%
  left_join(join_info, by = 'blockname') %>%
  mutate(
    time_rel   = time_bin / 1000,              # ms → s
    lick_hz    = count_binned / (100 / 1000)   # counts per 100 ms bin → Hz
  ) %>%
  select(-time_bin, -count_binned)

# population-level
df_binnedlick %>%
  group_by(set_id, solution, time_rel) %>%
  summarise(
    lick_hz_sem  = sd(lick_hz) / sqrt(n()),
    lick_hz_mean = mean(lick_hz),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  write_csv(str_c(dir_output, 'licking_binnedlick_trace_overall.csv'))

# subject-level
df_binnedlick %>%
  group_by(experiment, subject, set_id, solution, time_rel) %>%
  summarise(
    lick_hz_sem  = sd(lick_hz) / sqrt(n()),
    lick_hz_mean = mean(lick_hz),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  write_csv(str_c(dir_output, 'licking_binnedlick_trace_subject.csv'))
```

```{r}
# ── per-set_id binnedlick traces (full and filtlick) ─────────────────────────
# mirrors the FP PETH loop above; needed by sfig09c and any panel reading
# {set_id}_full_binnedlick_trace_overall.csv or {set_id}_filtlick_binnedlick_trace_overall.csv

for(loop_set_id in loop_set_ids) {

  df_bl_setid <- df_binnedlick %>%
    filter(set_id == loop_set_id)

  for(toggle_filt_trial_lick in c(0, 1)) {

    df_bl_filt <- df_bl_setid

    if(toggle_filt_trial_lick == 1) {
      df_bl_filt <- df_bl_filt %>% filter(trial_lick == 1)
      fn_prefix  <- str_c(loop_set_id, '_filtlick')
    } else {
      fn_prefix  <- str_c(loop_set_id, '_full')
    }

    # population-level
    df_bl_filt %>%
      group_by(set_id, solution, time_rel) %>%
      summarise(
        lick_hz_sem  = sd(lick_hz) / sqrt(n()),
        lick_hz_mean = mean(lick_hz),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_binnedlick_trace_overall.csv'))

    # subject-level
    df_bl_filt %>%
      group_by(experiment, subject, set_id, solution, time_rel) %>%
      summarise(
        lick_hz_sem  = sd(lick_hz) / sqrt(n()),
        lick_hz_mean = mean(lick_hz),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      write_csv(str_c(dir_output, fn_prefix, '_binnedlick_trace_subject.csv'))

  } # end full/filtlick loop
} # end set_id loop
```
